decisions.value: Build a new backend framework with its own programming model and runtime semantics.
AI agents across capability levels are the primary authors and operators.
No existing backend framework may own or implement the core service model or runtime.

evidence: E-001 parser and canonical IR prototype
decisions.reason: No agent-authored task study, hidden acceptance evaluation, or repeated agent-cost measurements have been completed.

evidence: E-002 shared HTTP conformance passes for Go, Rust, WASI P2, and BEAM
Second three-repetition smoke matrix using pinned toolchains and committed Cargo.lock files
decisions.reason: Both shared GitHub-hosted CI smoke matrices are explicitly not decision-grade; representative workloads and controlled dedicated-machine measurements remain outstanding.

decisions.value: The E-003 reference model is provisional and does not yet define production semantics.
evidence: Deadlines, cancellation, retries, worker crash, idempotency, and shutdown tests
decisions.reason: Durability, distributed atomicity, fairness, leases, clock skew, and multi-process fault injection remain unresolved.

decisions.value: The E-004 reference model is a provisional policy contract; no production authorization, sandbox, or secret-management architecture is selected.
evidence: Expiry and strict delegation attenuation tests
decisions.reason: Cryptographic grants, revocation, workload identity, storage isolation, sandbox enforcement, network egress, secrets, resource quotas, and human approval integration remain unimplemented.

decisions.value: The E-005 progressive-disclosure tool surface is a reference prototype; no transport or protocol is selected.
decisions.reason: Constrained/general/advanced agent trials, token and tool-call measurements, authenticated approval, and trusted mutation semantics remain outstanding.

decisions.value: E-006 SQLite implementation is a single-node semantic reference only; no production persistence or queue substrate is selected.
evidence: Lease expiry with monotonic fencing tokens
Crash rollback across local state/effect ledger/task completion
decisions.reason: External side-effect delivery, multi-node coordination, retention, schema evolution, recovery operations, and representative workload measurements remain outstanding.

decisions.value: E-007 defines public task statements and trace metrics only; acceptance oracles must remain outside the agent-visible workspace.
evidence: Metrics aggregation tests for tokens, tools, repairs, interventions, cost, wall time, and acceptance
decisions.reason: Isolated evaluator workspaces, external oracle packaging, provider telemetry adapters, pinned agent cohorts, and repeated trials remain outstanding.
